query: ChatGPT MCP app for API payments
answer_summary:
The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that enables AI models, such as ChatGPT, to interact seamlessly with external tools and services. This integration allows AI assistants to perform tasks like processing payments, managing subscriptions, and handling billing operations directly within the chat interface.

To facilitate API payments within ChatGPT using MCP, several solutions have been developed:

1. **MCPay**: An open-source infrastructure that adds on-chain payments to any MCP server using the x402 "Payment Required" protocol. It enables clients like ChatGPT to make pay-per-call requests without relying on static subscriptions or API keys. ([docs.mcpay.tech](https://docs.mcpay.tech/?utm_source=openai))

2. **Latch**: An open payment layer that brings x402 micropayments to any MCP server. Latch allows AI clients and developers to transact value directly, enabling pay-per-use functionality without subscriptions or API keys. ([docs.latchmcp.app](https://docs.latchmcp.app/?utm_source=openai))

3. **Magpie MCP Server**: Connects AI agents to the Magpie Payment Platform, allowing for processing payments, creating checkouts, sending invoices, and managing payment links
